notes.title: Build - v4.42.0
notes.content:
[fix] After purchasing the item game reloads

[fix] disassemble reload

[fix] progress bar glitches on event milestones
[fix] lottery didn't spend price
[fix] claim all pass reloads the game.
[fix] claim all milestones reloads the game
[fix] craft and rat reload

- Not limited massive dissasemble + dissasemble All.
- Instant gear loot claim.
- Instant chest loot ( not waiting for server response ).
- Improved server connection.
- Server Shop
- Option to purchase pass for in-game currency
- No portal to the Necromancer Altar ( not refreshed on Quests/Story )
- Possibility to share events between months with the seasonal points included ( points will go to new season post event )
- Better inventory server architecture - Transfer from old system after upgrade to new version NO COMING BACK IF THE USER UPDATED THE GAME 4.42.0 won't be able to login on lower version of the game on any device, account is transfered to new version. 
- repeatable milestone wasn't working correclty
- Show alert no items to dismantle ( instead of soulstone 0 )
- No hands on the quest collect 1 ore - Almost it's impossible to finish without, a better tool ( Lava ~10 picks ) base pick = IMPOSSIBLE
